components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main commit actions; inverted light fill on dark UI.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 30px; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--uprim, oklch(96.696% 0.0029 264.54)); color: var(--uprimfg, oklch(18.196% 0.0044 264.46)); font: 600 13px Urbanist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ufg, oklch(96.696% 0.0029 264.54)); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-btn-primary { transition: opacity 150ms ease, transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } }

components.name: Neutral Button
components.css: .ds-btn-neutral { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 30px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid var(--uline, oklch(29.312% 0.0095 268.35)); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--ubg, oklch(18.196% 0.0044 264.46)); color: var(--ufg, oklch(96.696% 0.0029 264.54)); font: 600 13px Urbanist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-neutral:hover { background: var(--uwell, oklch(19.595% 0.0062 271.09)); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-btn-neutral { transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .32, 1); } .ds-btn-neutral:active { transform: scale(0.97); } }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Run and connection status; tone carried by dot color.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 28px; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--upill, oklch(25.618% 0.0098 268.29)); color: var(--ufg, oklch(96.696% 0.0029 264.54)); font: 600 13px Urbanist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ok, oklch(77.294% 0.1535 163.22)); flex: none; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled inputs with persistent label and 30px control height.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 2px; font-family: Urbanist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ufg2, oklch(79.999% 0.0126 259.82)); } .ds-input { height: 30px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid var(--uline); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--ubg); color: var(--ufg); font: 400 13px Urbanist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ufg); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 14px; padding: 16px; max-width: 268px; border: 1px solid var(--uline, oklch(29.312% 0.0095 268.35)); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--usurf, oklch(20.924% 0.0061 271.12)); color: var(--ufg2); font-family: Urbanist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ufg); } .ds-card-desc { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ufg3); line-height: 1.45; }

narrative.overview: Compact, dark-first, cool neutral tooling where hierarchy comes from type, alignment, space, and subdued surfaces—not decorative chrome. Primary actions use opposing light/dark tones; semantic color always pairs with text or an icon. The system is built for long evaluation sessions: dense metadata, honest state labels, and dialogs that feel like calibrated instruments rather than marketing pages.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first with paired light theme via light-dark() tokens on :root
13px Urbanist UI base; boolean controls are two-tone, not accent-blue
Mosaic dialog headers and divided modal footers as approved exceptions
Intrinsic grids and container queries over breakpoint ladders
Icon before label on combined control affordances

rules.name: The Two-Tone Boolean Rule
rules.body: Checkbox, radio, and switch selected states use --uprim / --uprimfg; do not default selection to accent blue.

rules.name: The No Transition All Rule
rules.body: Never transition: all. Spatial motion belongs inside prefers-reduced-motion guards.

rules.name: The Focus Ring Rule
rules.body: One library-wide focus ring: 2px solid var(--ufg) at 3px offset; never outline: none without a replacement.

rules.name: The Icon-First Rule
rules.body: When a control shows icon and text, icon comes first in markup and reading order.

dos: Do use semantic CSS variables from Goldfin_Components tokens; derive tints with color-mix(in oklch, …).
Do keep application state and visible labels aligned—color alone never authorizes a processing state.
Do match dialog Cancel and primary button geometry (30px height, 0 11px padding).
donts: Don't introduce unregistered colors, glass, or decorative gradients outside sea/mosaic scope.
Don't use avatars in table or timeline designs supplied for this product.
Don't split token truth: frontmatter and tokens.css stay in sync on intentional changes.
